title: miconia thyrsiflora
intro: Miconia thyrsiflora, commonly known as the "Palo Santo," is a tropical evergreen tree native to Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal and spiritual properties. Miconia thyrsiflora has been traditionally used to alleviate respiratory issues, fever, and stress, while its essential oil is known to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Miconia thyrsiflora include limonene, alpha-pinene, and beta-pinene, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
